hero.title: Riya
hero.subtitleHTML: you're the person I text first about everything. this is me, every word, every little thing — for you.

intro.textHTML: riya, there are ten thousand reasons why you're my favorite person — and somehow, every single one of them is the way you laugh.

photos.title: our polaroids
photos.subtitle: tap any photo to see it larger. (swap the placeholders with our real ones — they'll fit perfectly.)

items.title: the hello
items.desc: you replied. and my whole chest rearranged itself around the sound of your name.

items.title: the first laugh
items.desc: the one where we couldn't stop. the one I replay in my head when I can't sleep.

items.title: the first 3am
items.desc: just five more minutes turned into the sun coming up and neither of us wanting to hang up.

items.title: the first fight
items.desc: the one I'd take back a thousand times. also — the day I realised you're not going anywhere.

items.title: the first "i got you"
items.desc: quiet, terrifying, and the truest thing I've ever said.

items.title: still us
items.desc: still choosing you. still going to. every single day.

reasons.title: reasons you're my favorite person
reasons.defaultText: tap below, bestie — I'll tell you why

items.t: the way you laugh — careless and loud and completely yours
how you always notice the small things I never say
your voice on late-night calls — like someone lit a candle
the way you hold your cup when it's too warm
you are soft where I am sharp, and sharp where I am soft
how you say my name like it matters
the way your eyes go bright before you laugh
you remember the version of me everyone else forgot
how even a dull day feels like something when you're in it
the way you steal my food and pretend you didn't
that little smile when you think I'm not looking
you make me want to be better without ever asking me to be
how you listen like the world can wait
the way you look in the morning when you've just woken up
you are my favorite song and my favorite silence
your fire — the soft, steady kind that never burns out
you feel like home without ever being a place
the way you forgive me faster than I forgive myself
because you exist, honestly
and because being your friend is the easiest thing I do

openWhen.title: open when…
openWhen.subtitle: tap each card when the feeling strikes

items.label: open when
items.title: you miss me
items.body: close your eyes. I'm holding your hand right now, right here, in this exact second. distance is only a rumour. 💜

items.label: open when
items.title: you're sad
items.body: you don't have to be okay. you don't have to explain. just breathe. I'm here, and I'm not going anywhere.

items.label: open when
items.title: you can't sleep
items.body: text me. I'll stay up with you. I'll be the 3am call, always.

items.label: open when
items.title: you're mad at me
items.body: I probably deserve it. I'm sorry. I'd rather be wrong and have you than right and far away.

items.label: open when
items.title: you forget you matter
items.body: scroll up. read the whole page again. every word here is me. every word is true.

items.label: open when
items.title: you want to smile
items.body: remember the ferris wheel? the noodles? the way you snorted when I said that dumb thing? — that. keep that.

quiz.eyebrow: how well do you know us?
quiz.title: a tiny bestie quiz

items.q: what's the first thing I noticed about you?
opts: the way you said my name
items.ok: your voice. it still gets me every time.
items.no: close — but it was your voice. it always is.

items.q: what's my favorite time of day with you?
items.ok: all of it. obviously all of it.

items.q: what do I think about when I can't sleep?
how long have you been stuck with me?
items.no: forever is the only real answer.

items.q: what would I trade for one more day with you?

items.no: all three. don't make me pick.

items.q: what's the truest thing I can say?
items.ok: all of them. every time. forever.
items.no: all of them, riya. all of them.

scratch.title: a secret for you
scratch.textHTML:
I knew the moment I met you —
you'd be someone I'd never want to lose.

constellation.title: our constellation
constellation.subtitle: a sky drawn just for you — watch it connect
constellation.message: written in the stars — you and me

milestone.title: counting down again
